[EN] left to find the secret to controlling the Storm Barrier, leaving Zolyn and Paesyn behind, and found a hidden cave.

Inside the cave was an unknown gate guarded by the Archdevan Imperial Army.

Defeating the guards, learned that the gate was connected to the Energia Celo.
[ES] se fue para encontrar el secreto para controlar la Storm Barrier, dejando atrás a Zolyn y Paesyn, y encontró una cueva oculta.

Dentro de la cueva había una puerta desconocida custodiada por la Archdevan Imperial Army.

Al derrotar a los guardias, descubrió que la puerta estaba conectada a la Energia Celo.

[EN] This is a foul, miserable place. No good will come of this.
[ES] Este es un lugar asqueroso y miserable. Nada bueno saldrá de aquí.

[EN] I watched you dispatch those archdevas outside, . I'm sorry I couldn't help, but I was ready to go for help, if you needed it!

Zolyn is on her way."Okay. When she gets here, tell her I've gone ahead."
[ES] Te vi deshacerte de esos archdevas afuera, . Lamento no haber podido ayudar, ¡pero estaba listo para ir por ayuda si la necesitabas!

Zolyn está en camino."Okay. When she gets here, tell her I've gone ahead."
